# Board geometry report, 2–15 players

Distance = moves from the start cell (step 0) to the finish with an exact roll; opening a token additionally needs a 6. Lane = 5 cells for every board. Track cells per side: ring boards have one seat segment per side; the square, rectangle and triangle fold each segment around an arm.

## Readability per device

A token is legible (symbol recognisable) from 24 px, which needs a 30 px cell. Values are px per cell with the whole board visible; **zoom** is the magnification the focus view needs to reach 30 px cells.
